notes.title: About the AI and version differences (a quick clarification)
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]We’ve received a few questions about how the game works and whether it uses AI. Here's a quick clarification:[/p][p]To comply with current platform policy, the Steam version of [i]Virtual Girlfriend[/i] [b]does not include AI-powered conversations[/b]. This is because, as of now, [b]games marked as “adults only” are not permitted to use AI features[/b] on this platform.[/p][p]That said, [b]all other features — especially those intended for mature audiences — remain fully present[/b] in the Steam version.[/p][p]If you’re looking for an [b]alternative version[/b] of the game with AI-driven dialogue and memory, it will be available on a different platform. You can find more details on our social pages or in the discussion threads.[/p][p]We respect every platform’s rules and deeply appreciate your support wherever you choose to play. [/p][p]Thanks again for your support and understanding. [/p][p]Don't forget to subscribe to the game's page on IndieDB so you don't miss anything: [url="https://www.indiedb.com/games/virtual-girlfriend"]https://www.indiedb.com/games/virtual-girlfriend[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45644897/bfa94af4fe73e218fa1fe746d343470dcff1f6f6.png"][/img][/p]
